thread:
isabel: Heads-up — requesting approval for a 12-month reserved GPU pool (H100) in us-west2. Proposal: 10 H100s reserved with 20% burst buffer. Estimated commit cost $72,000/mo vs on-demand ~$95,000/mo (~24% savings). Need PO + finance sign-off by EOD Fri to lock quoted price.

matt: Can you drop the cost calc and the perf baseline? want to sanity-check throughput assumptions.

isabel: pasted calc below:
```
Assumptions:
- instance: H100 1x
- on-demand: $13.2/hr -> monthly (720h) = $9,504 per GPU
- reserved (12mo, partial upfront): $7.2/hr -> monthly = $5,184 per GPU
- fleet: 10 GPUs -> on-demand = $95,040/mo, reserved = $51,840/mo
- add: network & storage uplift ~ $3k/mo, ops overhead ~ $1.2k/mo -> net reserved est $56k/mo
Vendor quoted total monthly commit (after taxes/fees): $72,000 (includes burst buffer & support premium)
Savings vs on-demand: ~24%
```

kate: SRE notes — we'll need extra snapshot retention for KV-cache nodes (+~$1.2k/mo). Also saw GPU mem pressure spikes yesterday on tempest-runner2 (90% mem). If canary saturates, ops cost could bump.

matt: Also callout: us-west2 egress and cross-AZ charges are higher for our pattern. If we concentrate capacity here we should optimize traffic paths. And confirm the AMI/kernel+driver matrix for H100.

billing-bot: Billing alert: detected ~40% higher transient spend in us-west2 over last 72h due to an autoscaler loop creating duplicate fleets. Investigating and correlating to reconciler errors.

june: (Finance) We have $250k GPU commit headroom for Q2. Approve in principle but need product-level allocation + PO number. Also ask vendor about multi-region hedging to avoid a single-region lock.

isabel: Breakdown: 60% search, 25% chat, 15% embeddings. Vendor terms: 12-month commit, 20% partial upfront, quarterly true-up window. I'll get written confirmation on burst/capacity guarantees.

luca: CTO — I'm +1 if this materially reduces unit cost and keeps performance. Proposal: canary first — reserve 6 H100 in us-west2 and 4 in us-east1 for failover. Gate final commit on canary metrics hitting SLOs. Also include rollback plan for region outage.

matt: One more: will reserving these as "committed" remove our ability to burst when needed? need clarity on burst behavior and penalty terms.

isabel: Vendor told us there is a 20% burst cushion subject to spare capacity in region. I'll request that in writing and add to procurement checklist.

kate: Action items I see:
1) Tag reserved instances 'commit-q2-h100'
2) Create PO + attach vendor quote
3) Infra runbook for autoscale failure and KV cache backups
4) Schedule canary deployment next Tue
I'll create tickets and link.

june: :thumbsup: please put tickets into finance-review board and include expected monthly cashflow. We need GL codes.

billing-bot: Update: autoscaler root cause = race in reconciler. Patch merged by @matt, will redeploy shortly. Estimated recoverable credit from vendor for duplicate fleets: ~$4.3k — opening a ticket with vendor.

isabel: Great — once I have burst confirmation + vendor credit note, I'll submit formal procurement doc and PO request. tagging @procurement.

procurement: On it — send over vendor quote PDF, W-9, and desired GL code and we'll draft the PO. Expect 48h turnaround once docs are in.

isabel: Uploaded vendor quote + cost model to drive docs (link). Also attached perf baseline for search pipelines.

luca: If procurement needs exec sign-off i approve now. Make sure risk doc about region outage + fallback is attached.

june: Final finance conditional approval: release funds if (1) canary results show <=5% latency regression on search SLO and (2) updated monthly forecast is included in capex/opex.

isabel: Acknowledged. I'll run the canary, capture SLO metrics, and post a short follow-up with tickets/PO link. Thanks everyone.
